itinerary.cal: Climbed roughly July-September once approach gullies and basin snowfields have melted out; a North Cascades National Park wilderness permit (walk-up only, issued in person at Marblemount) is required for the Crescent Creek Basin camp.

days.note: A steep, sweaty climb out of the Goodell Creek trailhead through forest and heather slopes over the Barrier into Crescent Creek Basin, gaining nearly 6,000 ft to a camp a little over 6,000 ft below the Southern Pickets crest. Parties carry a full multi-day rack, rope, and several days of food, since the route is entirely off-trail once past the first mile or two.
days.title: Approach to Crescent Creek Basin

schedule.label: Leave trailhead
schedule.detail: Goodell Creek TH, permit and rack in hand

schedule.label: Clear treeline
schedule.detail: Onto open heather and talus below the basin

schedule.label: Reach Crescent Creek Basin camp
schedule.detail: Bench a little over 6,000 ft below Mount Terror, with snowmelt water and views of the crest

days.objective: Reach the Crescent Creek Basin high camp

days.note: An alpine-start day climbing from camp to the Terror-Rake col, then following the crest on mixed 4th/5th-class terrain (to roughly 5.9) to the summit at 7,869 ft. The descent reverses the ridge with a series of rappels back to the col and down to camp, so the rope stays on for most of the day.
days.title: Climb The Rake, ridge traverse route

schedule.label: Leave camp
schedule.detail: Alpine start with rack, single rope, and minimal water/food

schedule.label: Gain the Terror-Rake col
schedule.detail: Steep gully/snow finger to the notch

schedule.label: Start ridge pitches
schedule.detail: Mixed climbing along the crest, up to 5.9 in spots

schedule.label: Begin rappel descent
schedule.detail: Reverse the ridge with a series of raps back toward the col

schedule.label: Back at Crescent Creek Basin camp

days.objective: Summit The Rake and return to Crescent Creek Basin camp

days.note: Break camp and descend the approach route in reverse — steep heather and forest back down to the highway. Knees take the brunt of it; most parties are back at the car by mid-afternoon.
days.title: Exit to trailhead
days.objective: Hike out to Goodell Creek trailhead

itinerary.totalNote: A 3-day trip: one day backpacking into Crescent Creek Basin camp, a long technical day climbing The Rake's ridge crest and rappelling back to camp, and a day hiking out — roughly 16 miles and ~8,100 ft of gain round trip.
